campaign_protocol.paired_design: Pair map seeds and starting positions, rotate civilizations and opponents; fix gameplay rules. Policy changes alter RNG consumption, so shared seeds alone do not provide identical later stochastic events.
campaign_protocol.holdout: Split by map/seed lineage and opponent configuration before tuning; hold out eras and map types. Do not score training maps as validation.
campaign_protocol.statistics: Use game or paired map block as the independent sampling unit; confidence intervals clustered by block. Predeclare metrics, minimum useful effect and sample size from pilot variance. Do not treat unit turns as independent games.

completed worthwhile voyages; unexplained stalled jobs and blocker recovery time
force arrival versus target window; losses and city losses
food/commerce/production trajectories and avoided idle assets
unsupported and infeasible predictions; forecast error and threat calibration
performance: early/mid/late-game p50/p95/p99 AI turn time under identical profiling conditions
